rows.market_wrap: Nifty rose 1.85% to 25,819 and the Sensex about 1,500 points as markets reopened after Tuesday's holiday and won back Monday's fall. Record foreign buying in November, Brent crude slipping to about $90 and a rupee at an eight-month high lifted banks, IT and FMCG (Nifty FMCG +3.8%); metals were the only sector to fall.
